मोद १

MODA I . A demon who was a companion of hiraṇyākṣa. In the Devāsura battle vāyu killed him.

मोद २

MODA II . A serpent born of the clan of airāvata. This serpent was burnt to death in the sarpasatra of janamejaya. (Śloka 10, Chapter 52, Āsramavāsika Parva).

मोदागिरि

MODĀGIRI . A country of ancient bhārata. The King of this country was killed by Bhīmasena. (Śloka 31, Chapter 30, Sabhā Parva).

मोदाकी

MODĀKĪ . A vast area of land in śākadvīpa near the mountain kesara. (Śloka 26, Chapter 11, bhīṣma Parva).

मोदापुर

MODĀPURA A country of ancient bhārata. arjuna defeated the King of this country once. (Śloka 11, Chapter 27, Sabhā parva).
